name: Pledge
description: Stake USDC on personal goals. 100% completion returns full stake; partial completion returns a proportional amount minus fee; failure forfeits tokens to treasury/charity.
policy: Please report vulnerabilities privately by emailing timknapp12@gmail.com. Include a clear description, reproduction steps, and an assessment of impact. Do not disclose publicly until the issue is patched and deployed. A good-faith acknowledgement will be provided; there is no formal bounty program at this time.
